import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
})

COLORS = {
    'voting': '#E69F00',
    'sj': '#56B4E9',
    'em': '#009E73',
    'fk': '#F0E442',
    'logprob': '#0072B2',
    'ensemble': '#CC79A7',
    'oracle': '#BBBBBB',
    'greedy': '#333333',
    'random': '#999999',
}

# ── Left panel data (sorted descending by AUROC) ──
left_labels = ['Ensemble\n(SJ+VC)', 'Voting\nConf', 'Soft\nJaccard', 'Exact\nMatch', "Fleiss'\nKappa", 'Log-prob']
left_values = [0.735, 0.704, 0.689, 0.640, 0.629, 0.591]
left_colors = [COLORS['ensemble'], COLORS['voting'], COLORS['sj'], COLORS['em'], COLORS['fk'], COLORS['logprob']]

# ── Right panel data ──
right_methods = ['Oracle', 'Log-prob', 'Ensemble', 'Soft Jacc.', 'Voting', 'Exact Match', 'Greedy', 'Random']
ner_f1 =       [0.769,    0.609,     0.604,      0.604,       0.596,    0.590,        0.609,   0.580]
re_f1 =        [0.561,    0.397,     0.367,      0.368,       0.338,    0.340,        0.374,   0.338]
right_colors = [COLORS['oracle'], COLORS['logprob'], COLORS['ensemble'], COLORS['sj'],
                COLORS['voting'], COLORS['em'], COLORS['greedy'], COLORS['random']]

greedy_ner = 0.609
greedy_re = 0.374

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4.5), gridspec_kw={'width_ratios': [1, 1.4]})

# ═══════════════ LEFT PANEL ═══════════════
x_left = np.arange(len(left_labels))
bars_left = ax1.bar(x_left, left_values, width=0.6, color=left_colors, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.8)
# Ensemble gets hatching
bars_left[0].set_hatch('///')
bars_left[0].set_edgecolor('#99507a')

ax1.set_ylim(0.55, 0.77)
ax1.set_xticks(x_left)
ax1.set_xticklabels(left_labels, fontsize=9)
ax1.set_ylabel('AUROC')
ax1.set_title('(a) Quality Estimation', fontweight='bold', pad=10)

for bar, val in zip(bars_left, left_values):
    ax1.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, val + 0.004, f'{val:.3f}',
             ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8.5, fontweight='medium')

ax1.axhline(y=0.5, color='#aaaaaa', linestyle=':', linewidth=0.7, alpha=0.5)

# ═══════════════ RIGHT PANEL ═══════════════
x_right = np.arange(len(right_methods))
bar_w = 0.35

bars_ner = ax2.bar(x_right - bar_w/2, ner_f1, bar_w, color=[c for c in right_colors],
                   edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.8, label='NER F1')
bars_re = ax2.bar(x_right + bar_w/2, re_f1, bar_w, color=[c for c in right_colors],
                  edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.8, label='RE F1', alpha=0.65)

# Oracle bars: dashed border, lighter
for b in [bars_ner[0], bars_re[0]]:
    b.set_edgecolor('#666666')
    b.set_linestyle('--')
    b.set_linewidth(1.5)
    b.set_alpha(0.45)

# Highlight log-prob RE bar (the one that beats greedy)
bars_re[1].set_edgecolor('#D55E00')
bars_re[1].set_linewidth(2.5)
bars_re[1].set_alpha(1.0)

# Greedy baselines
ax2.axhline(y=greedy_ner, color=COLORS['greedy'], linestyle='--', linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.7)
ax2.axhline(y=greedy_re, color=COLORS['greedy'], linestyle=':', linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.7)

# Label the greedy lines
ax2.text(len(right_methods) - 0.5, greedy_ner + 0.004, 'Greedy NER', fontsize=7.5, color=COLORS['greedy'],
         ha='right', va='bottom', fontstyle='italic')
ax2.text(len(right_methods) - 0.5, greedy_re + 0.004, 'Greedy RE', fontsize=7.5, color=COLORS['greedy'],
         ha='right', va='bottom', fontstyle='italic')

ax2.set_ylim(0.28, 0.82)
ax2.set_xticks(x_right)
ax2.set_xticklabels(right_methods, fontsize=9, rotation=25, ha='right')
ax2.set_ylabel('F1 Score')
ax2.set_title('(b) Best-of-N Selection', fontweight='bold', pad=10)

# Custom legend
legend_elements = [
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor='#777777', edgecolor='white', label='NER F1'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor='#777777', edgecolor='white', alpha=0.65, label='RE F1'),
    plt.Line2D([0], [0], color=COLORS['greedy'], linestyle='--', linewidth=1.2, label='Greedy baseline'),
]
ax2.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper right', framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#cccccc')

# ═══════════════ ANNOTATION ═══════════════
fig.text(0.5, -0.02, 'Gap: AUROC 0.70+  ↛  Selection > Greedy',
         ha='center', fontsize=10, fontstyle='italic', color='#555555')

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 1])

out = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0514_1/projects/struct_self_consist_ie/figures/paper/fig_selection_gap.pdf'
fig.savefig(out)
plt.close()
print(f'Saved: {out}')
